column10: Home of the Northern Cumberland's practices, so have been many times. Superb bells, especially the back 8.
My first 'I have a car now' practice.
Visited during the world cup semi-final. Difficult 5.
Visited for a practice once, and also on Elizabeth's tour. One of the best tower accesses I've encountered.
Rang a nice peal with CMM here, and failed one for MJLD's 50th. Also rang on Sunday with Izzy once or twice.
Nice spire with one of the most treacherous ladders I've attempted
My least-favourite bells to ring a peal on. But nice to do it for Hannah Baker's first.
Been on a DUSCR tour or two, and to some 'Jim's girls' practices
Visited on the first Olivgarchy trip, and for Sam's birthday tour. Failed to visit on the ramblers stragglers trip.
Visited on Jack's 12-grabbing trip. Were very difficult but did have ropes. Also had the most horrible church toilet I've ever encountered.
Unmemorable. Quite a swanky comfortable church. Got told off a lot for bad striking.
Failed peal attempt with John Pladdys. Nice bells.
Very fun drive on the way there. Needed new brakes.
My first 4. Nice view from the roof, and there was a cat at the co-op
Big airy church with quite difficult bells. Very pretty surroundings.
Very old bell. Matthew left his jumper here.
Largest tenor I've rung inside to major, up to that point. Sounded lovely.
Lottie's Home Tower, after Elizabeth crashed her car. Lovely bells.
A very quick grab before my unplanned day out in Lancaster
Nice old 10. Characterful. I had new brakes so was more happy.
Rang for a Sunday here. Nice view out the window, but the locals were quite baffled by us.
A stay was broken and I got in trouble for breaking into the belfry. Whoops.
Sunday morning on James' birthday weekend. First time I've encountered belfry praying.
Very enjoyable practice with good pub. While at the NAM conference.

I think this is the deepest-set bell I've encountered. Ophelia couldn't move it.
Failed to ring grandsire so rang PB. Nice village with chips.
A circular ringing chamber. Madness

Charlotte amusingly stalled her car outside this one
Nice market outside, didn't think much to the bells.
Mythili broke a stay here and we couldn't fix it. Very manky
My first Cumberlands practice. They were quite hard.
Daniel Page's Birthday peal. Very nice bells.
A ladder through one of the wheels hindered ringing somewhat. But I'm assured they're lovely.
Visited a random practice with MPB and ODWH

First successful test case for Brenda, for obvious reasons.
Visited on Sam's birthday tour. Very nice-sounding bells.

Mavis threatened to die on the way here, which precluded enjoyment somewhat.

Definitely the best tower access ever. Difficult bells though.
On Alice's QP day. Difficult to hear.
Very nice QP, interesting backwards staircase. First quarter to be Brenda'd.
My oldest tower to date (I think). Looked like a lighthouse.

Impressive church, inaudible bells
Biggest bells. Obvs.
Leeds branch learners' practice.
